subject: Seasonal Buoy Program - Maritimes
text:
Seasonal Buoy Program - Maritimes
Lifting of floating aids and decommissioning of fixed aids has commenced in the Atlantic South region, in the following areas:
New Brunswick coast, including the Bay of Fundy and Saint John river, Nova Scotia coast, including Cape Breton Island and Bras d'Or Lakes, Prince Edward Island coast, Gulf of St. Lawrence and Northumberland Strait, to the Quebec border.
